subtitle: Guide RNA Specificity, Off-Target Analysis & Cas9 Cleavage

glossary.definition: Protospacer Adjacent Motif; a short sequence required adjacent to the target site for Cas9 binding and cleavage.
Unintended CRISPR cleavage at genomic sites with sequence similarity to the intended guide RNA target.
Prime editing guide RNA; combines a spacer sequence with a reverse transcriptase template and primer binding site.
